title: Detronics Pte Ltd
description: Over the years, we went through 3 financial crisis in The 1997 Asian  Financial Crisis, The 2003 SARS Crisis and The 2008 Financial Crisis, with our Invaluable Customers’ support and our unwavering believe in providing the best to our customers. We have emerged stronger and have gone from strength to strength, to expand with offices in Hong Kong and Malaysia.
